reply.content:
**Yes.** CVS reported significant ongoing litigation, most notably opioid-related cases. In 2022, it recorded **$5.8 billion in opioid litigation charges** for settlements intended to resolve many claims by states, subdivisions and tribes; private-plaintiff cases remained ongoing. CVS was also appealing a **$651 million** judgment from an Ohio case arising from a 2021 jury verdict. Separately, PBM-related lawsuits and investigations, pricing litigation, and Medicare risk-adjustment audits and investigations were ongoing.

The filing cautions that it could not estimate the ultimate loss for all opioid matters. It also says accruals for outstanding legal matters were not material to financial condition individually or in aggregate—though the opioid charge was substantial. (pp. 170–175)
